verdict.rationale: The vendor's features page describes built-in AI inside Zoho Books. Users can "Ask Zia in plain English," the product will "spot anomalies before they become problems," and AI "turns financial data into the next step automatically" (for example, categorizing bank statements and suggesting collection reminders). Together these deliver in-product, data-driven insights and suggestions. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of what insights Zia surfaces and how, and any independent or hands-on corroboration; the evidence is a single marketing page.
